|-- [M] Modular structure -- semantic boundaries, exposed contracts, dependencies
|   |-- Proposal review: ChangeSessionService
|   |   |-- Public: capture(), create(), apply(), update(), accept()
|   |   |-- Read views: list(), get(), preview(), snapshot(), readDiffTree(), readTreemaps()
|   |   |-- Private: serialize(), mutate(), controller(), record(), validateReady()
|   |   |   `-- Keep replay, history mutation and readiness rules behind the service
|   |   `-- Depends on DiagramChangeSessionRepository + DiagramRepository + CanvasSessionPort
|   |       |-- repositories: resolve pinned Git context and capture hunks
|   |       |-- projectCatalogs: read published baselines and acceptCanvasChanges()
|   |       `-- bridge: inspect live canvases; MappingDocumentController handles proposal edits
|   |-- Automated preparation: DiffSessionWorkflowService + DiffSessionTools
|   |   |-- Public workflow: start(), get(), cancel(), dispose()
|   |   |-- Depends on ChangeSessionService, agent, runtime and DiffSessionRunStore
|   |   `-- DiffSessionTools.tools(step) exposes capabilities by stage
|   |       |-- analyze: API discovery, frozen diagram search, captured hunks, source reader
|   |       |-- materialize: add create, exec, draw, mappings, update, DiffTree read, complete
|   |       `-- Private bound(): require this run's changeSessionId; reject another proposal
|   |-- Evidence and validity: DiagramChangeSession + ChangeSessionDiffTree
|   |   |-- validateChangeSession(): repository context, document states, history, acceptance
|   |   |-- writeDiffTree(): tree revision and full mapping replacement together
|   |   `-- validateDiffTree(): stable node identities and valid, unique hunk targets
|   |-- Durable records: ChangeSessionRecords
|   |   |-- Public: readSummary(), readPreview(), readDiffTree(), read(), write()
|   |   `-- Private manifest/blob machinery depends on ImmutableRecords + DiagramPersistence
|   `-- Push entry: PushIntegrationService
|       `-- Depends on PushIntegrationStore + PushSource + PushWorkflow; exports receive()
|-- [C] Call model -- invocations that prepare, edit and publish a proposal
|   |-- Optional entry: PushIntegrationService.receive(connectionId, event)
|   |   |-- Validate event; reuse matching pending/stored generation or reject ID conflict
|   |   |-- Non-branch, deleted, unchanged or no net changes -> skipped
|   |   `-- source.resolve() -> workflow.start({commits, head: after, comparisonBase: before})
|   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService.start() -> begin() -> background execute()
|   |   |-- changes.capture() -> store context/prompts -> runtime.openSession()
|   |   |-- runAgentWorkflow(createDiffSessionWorkflow(...)) -> session.runStep(request)
|   |   |   |-- analyze: read frozen baselines and captured repository evidence
|   |   |   `-- materialize: tool callbacks operate on the run's isolated proposal
|   |   |       |-- create_diagram_change_session -> changes.create(input, capture)
|   |   |       |-- exec / draw_diagram / set_diagram_source_mappings -> agent.call(bound(input))
|   |   |       |-- update_diagram_change_session -> annotate changes and mark ready
|   |   |       `-- complete_diff_session -> require ready, nonempty changes, all hunks mapped
|   |   `-- changes.get(result.changeSessionId) -> verify own ready proposal -> completed
|   |       `-- Completion means ready for review; acceptance is a separate service call
|   |-- ChangeSessionService.apply(id, documentId, version, operations, requestId)
|   |   `-- mutate() -> controller(doc).applyUpdate(version, operations)
|   |       `-- record() -> refreshChanges() -> status = draft -> repository.write()
|   |-- ChangeSessionService.update({status: 'ready', expectedVersion, ...})
|   |   `-- mutate() -> validateReady() -> save versioned ready proposal
|   |       |-- Validate DiffTree, repository ownership, migrations and connection anchors
|   |       |-- Require changes; reject missing or cyclic DiagramChange.dependsOn references
|   |       `-- Added diagram requires an incoming edge from a diagram present in baseline
|   `-- ChangeSessionService.accept({changeSessionId, requestId, expectedVersion})
|       `-- serialize() -> get()
|           |-- Existing acceptance: matching request/version -> replay; mismatch -> conflict
|           `-- New acceptance: require expectedVersion + ready + validateReady()
|               |-- bridge.dispatch('document-state') for affected live documents
|               |   `-- Compare document stateKey and name with capture; changed -> conflict
|               |-- projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges(affected proposed documents + history)
|               |   `-- Pass savedRevisionId as expectedRevisionId for published-baseline check
|               `-- finishAcceptance(receipt) -> accepted, version + 1 -> repository.write()
|-- [O] Ownership -- who retains state and releases runtime resources
|   |-- ChangeSessionService.capture() owns the frozen inputs supplied to create()
|   |   |-- Published settled representations provide initial baselines
|   |   |-- Selected live snapshots replace matching baselines; multiple workspaces need canvasId
|   |   `-- baselineChangeSessionId reuses original baselines and pinned context/hunks
|   |       `-- structuredClone() + forkHistory(): fresh proposal state from the captured originals
|   |-- ChangeSessionDocument retains baseline, proposed, version and history
|   |   |-- create() clones captured documents; createDocument() starts with baseline = null
|   |   |-- controller() borrows proposal state; record() retains its snapshot and exported history
|   |   |-- Canonical history owns undo/redo; record() clears legacy past/future arrays
|   |   `-- mutate() rejects accepted/archived edits; ready edits can return to draft
|   |-- DiagramChangeSession.receipts retains signatures and prior mutation results
|   |   |-- create / request:<requestId> / api:<requestId> support replay
|   |   `-- Matching signature returns saved result before stale-version checks; mismatch conflicts
|   |-- ChangeSessionRecords retains immutable blobs behind a mutable manifest
|   |   |-- StoredDocument references baseline/proposed states and history header/checkpoints
|   |   |-- write(): retain unchanged references, store replacements, publishJson(manifest)
|   |   |-- Optional expected token prevents replacing a newer manifest generation
|   |   `-- validated/previews caches hold at most 16 entries each; reads return document clones
|   |-- projectCatalogs retains the authoritative ChangeSessionAcceptance receipt
|   |   `-- If session write fails after publishing: list() projects accepted; get() repairs record
|   `-- Runtime owners release transient work
|       |-- ChangeSessionService.queues / ChangeSessionRecords queues serialize writes, then remove entries
|       |-- PushIntegrationService.pending shares delivery execution; finally deletes its entry
|       `-- DiffSessionWorkflowService owns starts, active AbortControllers, live runs and agent session
|           |-- cancel() aborts; dispose() aborts active runs and disposes runtime
|           `-- execute() finally saves artifacts, disposes session, saves run; completion clears active/live
`-- [+D] Data dependency -- required inputs to results, independent of organizational boundaries
    |-- ChangeSessionCapture [shared capture]
    |   |-- context <- repositoryId + resolved commits/head + optional comparisonBase
    |   |-- hunks <- repositories.captureHunks(context)
    |   `-- documents <- published revisions + selected live snapshots, or original session baselines
    |       `-- Same capture feeds workflow analysis and changes.create(); materialization reuses it
    |-- DiagramChange[] <- refreshChanges(baseline, proposed, previous annotations)
    |   |-- baseline = null -> type 3 canvas change
    |   |-- revisionReviews/revisionSelections differ -> subtree-variant change
    |   `-- Display-node or incident-edge difference -> diagram change; preserve matching annotations
    |-- DiffTree hunk selection <- revision.nodeRefs + mappings + captured hunks
    |   |-- writeDiffTree(): source line/nodeId -> stable nodeId -> hunkId targets
    |   |-- resolveDiffTreeHunks(nodeIds): resolve node resources -> deduplicated hunkIds
    |   `-- complete_diff_session(): captured hunk IDs minus mapped hunk IDs must be empty
    |-- Acceptance payload <- changes + proposed documents + exported history + savedRevisionId
    |   |-- changes.documentId selects affected documents; unrelated captured documents stay unpublished
    |   |-- Live conflict decision <- current.document/name + captured baseline.document/name
    |   `-- Replay/repair decision <- catalog receipt.requestId/sessionVersion + stored session.version
    `-- Read projections require different subsets of the same stored generation
        |-- readSummary() <- Manifest.summary
        |-- readPreview() <- metadata + baseline/proposed blobs; omits histories and receipts
        |-- read() <- documents + histories + receipts + DiffTree; returns manifest token
        `-- readTreemaps() <- stored DiffTree + document previews + matching effective versions
            `-- Version mismatch during assembly -> VERSION_CONFLICT; caller must retry
